links.outcome: Sensitivity for lymph node metastasis reported separately by site across hospitals
links.effect: Retrospective sensitivity ranged from 0.97 (95% CI 0.92-0.99) to 1.00 (0.98-1.00) across 16 hospitals; prospective 0.93 (0.78-0.99) to 1.00 (0.98-1.00) across nine hospitals.
links.quote: In the prospective validation, PanCAM exhibited sensitivity ranging from 0·93 (0·78-0·99) to 1·00 (0·98-1·00) across nine hospitals.

links.outcome: Additional metastasis patients detected by AI versus pathologists on same data
links.effect: PanCAM identified 120 additional patients with lymph node metastasis missed by pathologists in retrospective validation and 21 additional in prospective validation.
links.quote: At the patient level, PanCAM identified 120 additional patients with lymph node metastasis who were missed by pathologists in the retrospective validation and 21 additional cases in the prospective validation.

screen.reason: Multicentre diagnostic study validating an AI model for pan-cancer lymph node metastasis detection, including prospective multi-site clinical validation and comparison against pathologists.
